title: Rupee falls 27 paise to 95.79 against US dollar in early trade
text: Rupee falls 27 paise to 95.79 against US dollar in early trade. At the interbank forex market, the rupee opened at 95.70 against the US dollar but fell to 95.79, losing 27 paise from its previous close
